All matches the plan — no unrelated files touched. Final verification: all four checks (codegen, lint, test, build) passed cleanly, and I've appended the `## X6` entry to `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md`.

## Summary

I closed the two gaps assigned in `.studio-run/prompts/X6.md`:

**N5 — silent plafon-cron failures.** `enforceGlobalCostCap` now wraps `applyGlobalCostAction` in try/catch: on any error it writes one `cron_failed` row per day to `studioCostAlarms`, emails admins the exact error message (deduped to once/day, same as the alarm), then re-throws so Convex's own function log still shows the failure. A new `studioCronHeartbeats` row is refreshed at the end of every *successful* pass (a thrown mutation rolls itself back, so a stuck cron shows no heartbeat). The admin "Potrošnja" panel now shows "poslednja provera plafona: pre X min" (red past 60 min or absent) plus the last failure message if one exists today.

**N7 — input files retained forever.** `deleteJob` now deletes a job's input `studioUploads` rows and blobs, but only storageIds no other job of that user still references (full scan, since a wrong delete here destroys another job's file). `finalizeOutput` extends (never shortens, via `Math.max`) each input's `expiresAt` to match the job's own output expiry, so the existing `expireGenerationFiles` cron sweeps them together with no new cron needed. `getJobForRegenerate` now reports a deleted/expired input as an empty slot plus a `missingSlots` list instead of a broken thumbnail, so "Generiši ponovo" locks the button with the existing "Dodaj sliku" messaging and a short explanation, rather than only failing after a click.

All four gates (`codegen`, `lint`, `test` — 826 passing, `build`) pass cleanly, and only the files relevant to this step were touched.
